principle: One verified official document may create independent impacts across four domain outputs without duplicating crawler infrastructure.

outputChannels.affectsMissionTruth: Updates canonical mission identity metadata, eligibility criteria, or authority mapping.
outputChannels.affectsCareerSignal: Emits an OPPORTUNITY_SIGNAL or PROCESS_UPDATE_SIGNAL to student feeds.
outputChannels.affectsAcademicTruth: Triggers updates to official syllabus atom structures or subject blueprints.
outputChannels.affectsPyqPattern: Updates objective preliminary pattern definitions, total marks, or marking scheme.
